full_judgment:
The opposite party as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 253 of 1993 in the Court of Assistant Judge, 6th Court, Dhaka for a decree of declaration that the order as contained in office reference No. Marketing/3090037 dated 8.9.93 issued by defendant No. 7 is illegal, void, inoperative and not binding upon the plaintiff and for mandatory injunction for reconnecting the gas line described in the schedule of the plaint. The plaintiff is the Managing Director of Amena Dyeing and Hossain Screen (Pvt) Ltd, situated at 5/1-A Jurain, PS Demra. He obtained gas connection in the factory. The defendants on 16.3.92 disconnected the gas line of the factory for arrear of outstanding bills. The plaintiff applied to the defendants for reconnection of the gas line. Thereafter the defendants directed the plaintiff to deposit 30% of the outstanding gas bill, reconnection fee and modified security money by their letter dated, 1.3.93. Accordingly, the defendants issued a demand note on 28.3.93 for gas bill of Taka 82,853.26 and reconnection fee of 10.000.00. The sum total bill is Taka 92,453.00 and odd. Accordingly, the plaintiff paid the amount on 29.3.93 through bank. The plaintiff also paid the modified security money on 30.3.93. In spite of such deposits, the defendant did not reconnect the gas line. Rather they removed the SST Meter on 26.4.93. Thereafter the defendant by issuing a demand note dated 8.9.93 claimed outstanding amount of money to reconnect the disputed gas line. The plaintiff termed this demand note as illegal, unauthorized, inoperative and not binding upon the plaintiff. Thereafter, the plaintiff applied for temporary connection of their gas line until final decision in the matter but till then no steps having been taken by the defendants, the plaintiff filed the suit for declaration.
